registryCustodian: Distrito Especial, Portuario, Industrial, Turístico y Biodiverso de Barrancabermeja; IGAC publicly evidenced municipal habilitation as gestor catastral by Resolución 681 of 1 June 2022, with service beginning 19 September 2022. The municipal planning portal also publishes cadastral resolutions. IGAC remains the national cadastral authority and public map publisher.
serviceReview: The IGAC REST folder https://mapas.igac.gov.co/server/rest/services/catastro returned service metadata. Gestores_Catastrales/MapServer layer 1 is a municipal polygon layer with fields including divipola, municipio, gestor_catastral, estado_actual, acto_admin, inicio, url_servicio, and geometry; its declared CRS is EPSG:9377. A bounded feature query for Barrancabermeja timed out once and a repeat filtered request was blocked by the host as unauthorized activity; neither returned a feature. This is custodian/coverage evidence, not parcel geometry evidence. Colombia en Mapas loaded as an official viewer shell but reported that required components could not load in the fetched session. No login, credential, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, TLS exception, or unsafe-field request was used.
